title: Jacobikerk — Le Guess Who?
role: Light design, immersive projection & live operation
excerpt: A site-specific light intervention for Le Guess Who? festival in the historic Jacobikerk, Utrecht.
description:
For Le Guess Who? 2022 I turned the historic Jacobikerk in Utrecht into an immersive projected space for the festival's concert programme — the setting for performances by Mabe Fratti, Hatis Noit and Hinako Omori. I made the work with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Molle, projecting from my own equipment with lenses from the LiGHT-UP Collective. During the concerts I operated the show lighting and the video live at the same time, shaping both from the desk as each set unfolded.
> Working with the church's gothic architecture, the design wrapped the nave and its chandeliers in slow, shifting light — turning the building itself into an instrument of atmosphere.
credits: Concept, light design & projection: Jaco Schilp, with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Molle. Projection equipment: Studio Schilp, with lenses from the LiGHT-UP Collective. Presented with Uncloud at Le Guess Who? 2022, Jacobikerk, Utrecht. Photography: Jaco Schilp.
